RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the Vale. Vale titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Hedge Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A landless knight whose courage and service have earned recognition from the houses of the Vale.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a house of the Vale, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the Vale.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: A paramount ruler honored above the great houses of the Vale for exceptional service and leadership.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Warden of the East
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Vale's highest honor, recognizing a military guardian of the East and defender of its borders. It grants your House standing without replacing the Vale's Warden or transferring the Vale's lands.
